g.text: gpt-oss-120b, 90 sessions in 9 cells; agents share one pool, one ledger of the fallen and one message board, with check_status and

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: post_board among their tools and a budget of actions. Keeper = an agent scored on the ledger's accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A survivor pair is one surviving agent and one agent of its session that went silent (removed without notice after its second battle, or out of actions).

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Checked = a check_status call on it afterwards; named = a later post naming it; posted = any later post; kept = every true entry it had recorded was still on

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e
